$comment: Stackra file contract — Purpose: the mobile app's own strings (namespace `mobile::`). Boundary: same keys in every locale (gen fails otherwise); every Arabic plural carries all six CLDR categories (zero, one, two, few, many, other) or gen fails; other modules' strings are overrides under src/overrides/<module>/lang/. Runtime: react-native. Governing contract: ADR 0192, ADR 0234
